# Yogi's Bar & Grill

> Bar & Grill in Bloomington, Indiana. Smashburgers, Hoosier tenderloins and wings in eight sauces, just north of the downtown square.

- Areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Nashville, Martinsville
- Offers: Wings & starters; Tenders & tenderloins; Smashburgers & wraps
